description: On the green-covered bed in front of you, there’s a pile of colorful plastic beads, a black tape dispenser, and a red string with some yellow beads already on it. The left hand holds the red string near its end while the right hand pinches a small yellow bead and aligns its hole with the string, slides the bead onto the string, then pulls the string taut and reaches back toward the bead pile to continue threading.
